title: BabyCraft (Tiny Takeover+)
description: A cute, cozy, and minimalist Vanilla experience! Play with a chibi baby model and clean 8x8 textures. Perfect for a soft look and high FPS.
body:
About the PackThis modpack turns Minecraft into a cozy, miniature world without touching the classic vanilla gameplay. It is designed for anyone who wants a clean, cute aesthetic and a smooth, high-FPS experience.

What changes?

Chibi Player Model: You play as a tiny baby-sized character.

8x8 Textures: Everything is scaled down to 8x8 pixels. The world looks cleaner, softer, and runs much better on any PC.

100% Vanilla: No complicated tech, magic, or weird mechanics. Just standard Minecraft with a much cuter look.Perfect for casual survival, building, or playing on low-end hardware.

⚠️ Warning: To get the baby character model working, you need to download the required .bbmodel file available on our Discord server.
